name: Busted Love
source:
On your way home from work you get stranded in the middle of the road in the middle of a storm. A nearby motel will be your refuge, without knowing that there you will find dangers and some broken love.

[From [url=https://looneylonelystudios.itch.io/busted-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在下班回家的路上，你在暴风雨中被困在路中央。附近的一家汽车旅馆将成为你的避难所，却不知道在那里你会发现危险和破碎的爱情。

[来自[url=https://looneylonelystudios.itch.io/busted-love]itch.io[/url]]
